display_name: 小米遥控器 Vibe Coding Codex for macOS
description: Use a Xiaomi Bluetooth Voice Remote 2 Pro with Codex on macOS. Hold to dictate with local Whisper or Qwen, review the transcript before sending, and switch between mouse and keyboard controls. Includes custom mappings, device scanning, battery status, and an interactive 3D remote. Based on MI-AO.
